targets.outcome_quote: This exact multilab replication study shows that the emergence and persistence of peer-sanctioning institutions in experimental public goods settings is a robust phenomenon.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors give an overall robust-phenomenon verdict and explicitly conclude competitive advantage is established. Their overall judgment takes precedence over two sites missing preregistered criteria and first-round differences. Seven sites test one original paper.
